overview: 9th-generation Camry launched for MY2025, marking a complete shift to hybrid-only powertrain across all trims (no more V6, no more 4-cyl ICE). All Camrys now use the 5th-generation Toyota Hybrid System with 2.5L Atkinson-cycle inline-4 plus electric motors. FWD output 225 hp, AWD output 232 hp. Combined fuel economy: 51 mpg (LE FWD). The car continues to be Toyota's flagship midsize sedan and remains assembled in Georgetown, Kentucky — a key for federal IRA eligibility. Source: https://www.toyota.com/camry/ ; https://pressroom.toyota.com/2025-toyota-camry/
